themes: Patience of the Prophet (peace be upon him)
summary_for_children: At-Tur means The Mount. It swears by the mount, a written book and the raised heaven, and tells the Prophet (peace be upon him) to be patient and glorify Allah.
world_title: The Mount and the Raised Heaven
environment_concept: A lone mountain (52:1), an open scroll on a stone (52:3) and a high sky (52:5).
architecture_and_scenery: A lone mountain, an open scroll on a stone, a distant house, a high sky and a glowing sea.

areas.name: Parchment Spread Open
areas.description: An open scroll on a stone; text is the ayah itself.

activities.name: Oaths path
activities.description: Lay six numbered stones in order, one for each of the first six ayahs.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Glorify at night
activities.description: Glorify at night and as the stars set (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration keeps the unseen as words only.

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (birds, mountain, scroll) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.tier: conceptual for the new engine (an older composed scene exists; not validated as unique)
